title: Decision: SseData intermediate type protects against malformed JSON silently
description: Lines 142-145: parse_sse_event silently deserializes SseData (the intermediate struct at lines 55-60). If JSON parsing fails, the function returns an empty Vec rather than propagating an error. This is intentional per the docstring (line 120): malformed SSE data doesn't crash the client. The client must resync via Message/changes if it misses events. This trades information loss for robustness in an untrusted stream.
